name: Tippie College of Business
note: Full-time MBA discontinued. Tippie announced in August 2017 it would phase out the full-time MBA; the final cohort graduated in May 2019. The school shifted to part-time, online, and specialized master's programs. Sources: Poets and Quants (2017) https://poetsandquants.com/2017/08/22/iowa-tippie-to-end-full-time-mba-program/ and Tippie College news (2024) https://tippie.uiowa.edu/news/2024/03/incredible-iowa-how-tippie-college-got-back-game-after-ending-its-full-time-mba
notes: Tippie announced in August 2017 that it would end its full-time on-campus MBA; the Class of 2019 was the final cohort, so the program stopped admitting after the fall 2017 intake and ended in 2019. Confirmed by the college's own news site, which states the full-time MBA ended in 2019. Successors: online Iowa MBA (launched fall 2019, now the flagship with strong growth), the part-time professional Iowa MBA, and specialized masters (Finance, Business Analytics). Sources: https://tippie.uiowa.edu/news/2024/03/incredible-iowa-how-tippie-college-got-back-game-after-ending-its-full-time-mba
